true_principle: **Context shapes choice**: Behavior is inseparable from the environment in which it occurs. Before attributing behavior to character or attitude, change the context and observe what changes.

consequences.phase_order: Every phase after the first defends the already-designed intervention instead of producing it, so the later-run phases read as justification rather than analysis.
consequences.technique: All ten proposal items apply the one overused technique, so the intervention method never varies across the set.
consequences.principle: The false principle governs the definition of success, so each item is written as a quick behavioral measurement rather than as a context change.
